name: Securian Financial
verdict: Securian Financial Group, Inc., a St. Paul-based insurer wholly owned - through Securian Holding Company - by Minnesota Mutual Companies, Inc., a mutual holding company. Nothing found.
note: Rating note: Securian Financial is the marketing name for Securian Financial Group, Inc., whose ultimate parent is Minnesota Mutual Companies, Inc. (per a 2017 SEC information statement). Previous rating note (removed 2026-09-25): its only claim then was an invented ownership record (#279). Rated 2026-10-05: none - privately held (mutual) US insurer; the SEC DEF 14C names no state or state-fund anywhere in the chain, and nothing found against the company itself in the last 20 years.
